guidance.bestFor: A button beside a small square avatar slot that fills with the picked image, with its name and a Remove link below
agentNotes: `useFileUpload` here sets no `maxSize`, so an image of any size is accepted; pass a limit in bytes

whenNotToUse.when: Many images collected in a grid that people drag in from the desktop

guidance.bestFor: A round dashed avatar that is itself the click and drop target, with a corner X, a size hint and an error alert below
agentNotes: `defaultAvatar` shows a saved image, but the corner X renders only for a new pick, so a saved avatar cannot be cleared here
`onFileChange` fires with null before every new pick as well as on removal, so a null alone does not mean the user cleared it

whenNotToUse.when: A profile picture displayed read only, with nothing to pick or drop

name: c-file-upload-3
title: Basic drag and drop file upload
label: Drag & Drop
description: Basic drag and drop file upload

guidance.bestFor: A single row dashed strip holding an Add files button, 48px thumbnails in line and a count against the limit
agentNotes: The remove `Button` on each thumbnail shows only on hover and has no accessible name; give it a label and a focus style

whenNotToUse.when: Picks that need their names, sizes and a progress bar listed in full

guidance.bestFor: A square image grid under a large drop zone, where a zoom button opens the full picture in a Dialog, with a total size and Clear all
agentNotes: `defaultImages` seeds 3 picsum.photos URLs through `initialFiles`; load the user's saved images there or drop the option
The zoom and remove `Button` pair on each tile appears on hover only with no accessible names; add labels and a focus reveal

whenNotToUse.when: Mixed documents where each one needs a progress bar and a retry

guidance.bestFor: A stacked list of cards, each with a thin bar while sending and an inline retry alert, under completed, failed and uploading counts
agentNotes: `simulateUpload` runs a 500ms timer that advances progress and fails files at random; replace that effect with your upload's progress events
`defaultImages` adds 2 finished grayscale picsum.photos rows; remove them or map the user's stored files

whenNotToUse.when: Documents laid out in columns for name, type, size and actions

guidance.bestFor: Rows in a Table with type and size columns, a ring around each icon while sending, and per row download, delete or retry
agentNotes: The download `Button` in each row has no `onClick`; point it at the file's `preview` URL or your storage link
`defaultFiles` seeds 4 finished rows whose /media/files URLs are placeholders; replace them with the user's stored files
`simulateUpload` fakes progress on a timer and marks about 1 in 10 finished files as failed; wire real upload events instead

whenNotToUse.when: A lighter list of cards with a bar under each name and no columns

guidance.bestFor: Product shots in a 4 column grid above a dashed Card drop area, with a progress card per new image that counts up its percent
agentNotes: `simulateUpload` fakes progress with a 100ms timer per image; send the file to your API from `addImages` instead
`visibleDefaultImages` holds 4 picsum.photos samples in their own grid apart from new uploads; replace or drop them
`onUploadComplete` is passed the list from before the new image was added, so read `images` state for the finished set

whenNotToUse.when: Product shots the user drags into a display order before saving

guidance.bestFor: A 5 column grid reordered by a grip handle on hover, where new images join the same order as the sample shots
agentNotes: Each reorder calls `toast` from sonner, which shows nothing unless your app mounts its Toaster
The order lives only in `allImages` state; save it from the `Sortable` `onValueChange` handler
`simulateUpload` ticks a fake percent every 100ms; replace it with your upload inside `addImages`

whenNotToUse.when: Photos kept in the order they were added, with no dragging

guidance.bestFor: Square preview cards in a grid of up to 6 columns, a ring over each while sending and a tooltip retry on failure
agentNotes: `defaultFiles` points 2 of its 3 samples at /media/files placeholder paths; swap in the user's stored files
`simulateUpload` fakes progress and fails about 1 in 10 files at the end; feed real upload events into `uploadFiles` instead

whenNotToUse.when: Documents listed as rows with type and size columns

guidance.bestFor: A wide 21:9 banner with Change Cover and Remove on hover, a percent ring while sending and an image guidelines box below
agentNotes: The empty state prints Max size 5MB as fixed text, so edit it whenever you change `maxSize`
`simulateUpload` fakes the percent ring on a 200ms timer; start your real upload where `onImageChange` fires
`defaultCoverImage` is a picsum.photos placeholder; pass the saved cover or start `coverImage` at null

whenNotToUse.when: Several product photos shown side by side in a grid
